title: The Shortest Queue
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：line　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 line 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My first paid job was behind a till in a shop that sold everything and arranged nothing. The ① line at my till was the shortest in the building, because I was slow. Painted on the floor was a yellow ② line that nobody stood behind, and the telephone, whose ③ line had been bad for eleven years, rang more often than the till.

My manager wrote ④ lines in a notebook — sentences to use when a customer was angry — and made me learn them by heart. In this ⑤ line of work, she said, you either learn the script or you learn the people. 'Don't give me that line,' one man said when I tried the first of them, and he was right: what worked instead was saying nothing for four seconds.

Deliveries were the part I was good at: carrying boxes, reading addresses, and learning which streets ⑥ line the hill and which run away from it. The driver, sixty years old and thirty years at it, knew the ⑦ line the van took on Fridays and the three roads it avoided. The line, he said, is the only thing a driver inherits from the one before him, and most drivers inherit nothing at all.

In ⑧ line with the shop's rules I was not allowed to give refunds, and I gave three, all wrongly, and was never found out. The last ⑨ line I remember hearing there came from a woman returning a kettle: 'I don't want the money, I want somebody to say it was not my fault.'

I said it was not her fault, and she cried, which was not in the notebook. I have worked in four offices since, and I have never again watched a ⑩ line form in front of me, and I miss it: a queue is the only place where a stranger will tell you, unasked, what kind of day they are having.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 队；列；排队的人
D. n. 话；说法；套话（that line）
E. n. 行业；行当（line of work）
F. n. 路线；线路（车辆行进的路线）
G. v. 沿……排列；成行分布于（line the streets）
H. 固定搭配：in line with 按照；与……一致

items.q: a yellow line that nobody stood behind
whose line had been bad for eleven years
My manager wrote lines in a notebook
the line the van took on Fridays
In line with the shop's rules
The last line I remember hearing there
watched a line form in front of me

answers.why: 指收银台前排的“队”，说“我”这队最短，因为动作慢。
指地上漆的黄色“线条”，说没人站在线后。
指电话“线路”，说这条线十一年都听不清却没人修。
lines 指“说法、套话、台词”，即经理写好让“我”背下的那几句。
line of work 意为“行业、行当”，经理说这行要么学会话术要么学会看人。
line 作动词，意为“沿……排列、成行分布”，说哪些街道沿山排开。
指货车周五走的“路线”，司机还知道该避开的三条路。
in line with 意为“按照、与……一致”，此处说按店规不能退款。
同样指“一句话、说法”，说那是在店里记得的最后一句话。
再次指排成的“队”，说此后办公室里再没人排着队等“我”。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我收银台前的队伍是全店最短的。（line）
地上漆了一条黄线，没人站在线后。（line）
那条电话线十一年都是坏的。（line）
经理在笔记本里写下了几句应付生气顾客的套话。（lines）
在这一行，你要么学会话术，要么学会看人。（line of work）
按店规，我不能退款，可我退了三次。（in line with）
answers: The line at my till was the shortest in the building.
A yellow line was painted on the floor, and nobody stood behind it.
That telephone line had been bad for eleven years.
My manager wrote lines in a notebook to use when a customer was angry.
In this line of work you either learn the script or you learn the people.
In line with the shop's rules I was not allowed to give refunds, but I gave three.
